microsoft365Fields.accountHelp: The Microsoft 365 mailbox this source reads.
microsoft365Fields.readsMailHelp: Messages, folders and attachment details of this mailbox. Nothing is changed in it.
microsoft365Fields.connectFailed: The sign-in could not be completed.
microsoft365Fields.notSetUp: Your organization has not connected Microsoft 365 yet.
microsoft365Fields.notSetUpAsk: Your organization has not connected Microsoft 365 yet. Ask an administrator to set it up under {{where}}.
microsoft365Fields.whoseHelp: One mailbox is connected by its owner. The organization's mailboxes are read with the organization's own access, once an administrator has allowed it.
microsoft365Fields.groupHelp: The group's address, or its ID as Microsoft Entra shows it. Members of groups inside it are included.
microsoft365Fields.everyMailbox: One table holds every mailbox's rows. A role that may read the table reads every mailbox, unless a row rule on the account column says otherwise.
microsoft365Fields.notAllowed: Your organization has not allowed sources that read its mailboxes.
microsoft365Fields.notAllowedAsk: Your organization has not allowed sources that read its mailboxes. Ask an administrator to allow it under {{where}}.
